display.title: Episode 459: Little Zalmy and the Spooky House, Chapter 1 (Asarah B'Teves)
display.summary_short: Right after Chanukah, Uncle Yossi begins the story of young Schneur Zalman's secret baskets of food and a spooky house in Liozna, and explains why we fast on Asarah B'Teves.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Asarah B'Teves 5751, just after Chanukah. Uncle Yossi opens with warm memories of the Chanukah lights, songs and parties, and the whole family joins in the Hakochainik march. A rabbi brings his three children to Studio 604 to recite the Shema, and everyone puts coins in the pushka. Story time begins 'Little Zalmy and the Spooky House', a true story about the Alter Rebbe as a six-year-old boy in Liozna. Following his parents' example of hachnasas orchim and kindness, little Schneur Zalman fills two baskets with food from the kitchen, tells the puzzled family cook that he is on a secret mission to save some hungry souls, and runs off. Meanwhile two boys, Shimmy and Zelig, set out to solve the mystery of an old, empty house that frightens the whole town; the chapter ends as they head toward it. Next, Uncle Yossi teaches about the fast of the tenth of Teves: there is a time for everything, even a time to be sad, so we remember Nevuchadnetzar's siege of Yerushalayim, which led to the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash, learn from it, and pray that Moshiach will soon turn these fast days into Yomim Tovim. The show closes with Shabbos candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: You are never too young to help others; and we remember sad days in order to improve ourselves, learn Torah, keep mitzvos and bring Moshiach.

date.note: 'This coming Thursday is Asarah B'Teves' (27 Dec 1990); follows episode 458 on Zos Chanukah (18 Dec).
